5435.title: Offscreen resize anchoring during backward touch scrolling
5435.rootCauseOneLine: The cached-row resize policy rejects scroll compensation during backward scrolling even when the changed row is wholly above the viewport.
5435.proposedFix: Remove the backward-direction exclusion only for measured rows entirely above the viewport; preserve viewport-intersection, bottom-pinning and iOS guards.
5435.caveats: Synthetic repository-only component fixture in emulated Linux Chromium touch. Third-party plugin, physical devices and Safari were not tested. Fix withheld: batch timeline suite still fails an error-alert test even though isolated baseline and post-fix retries pass.
